description: This file defines a Perl module named 'azure' that provides functions for interacting with Azure DevOps test management API. The functions include checking environment variables, creating test runs, creating test results, updating test results, and updating test runs. It exports several functions for external use and uses standard modules like POSIX.

methods.name: azure_check_environment
methods.description: Checks for necessary Azure environment variables to confirm the environment is configured for Azure DevOps testing.

methods.name: azure_create_test_run
methods.description: Creates a new test run in Azure DevOps using provided cURL command and environment variables, returning the test run ID.

methods.name: azure_create_test_result
methods.description: Creates a new test result entry for a specific test case within a test run, returning the result ID.

methods.name: azure_update_test_result
methods.description: Updates an existing test result with outcome, timestamps, and duration based on test execution, returning the result ID.

methods.name: azure_update_test_run
methods.description: Marks an Azure DevOps test run as completed.
